Transaction Privilege Tax and Use Tax exemptions on equipment, 10-20yr. Discloses recipients via annual reports. (StreamDC; GJF Cloudy Data)
Limited incentives under Act 819/Act 548 but not DC-specific sales tax exemption. No disclosure. (StreamDC)
No DC-specific incentive. High taxes, stringent environmental regulations, carbon neutrality mandates. Regulatory friction. (StreamDC; MultiState)
No DC-specific incentive currently. Expansion proposals under consideration in 2026. (MultiState 2026)
Data Center Tax Incentive Program via DECD, 20-30yr exemptions. Discloses recipients. (StreamDC; GJF Cloudy Data)

Sales/use tax exemption for 100MW+ IT load facilities (eff. Aug 2025). Covers infrastructure, equipment, electricity. No disclosure. (StreamDC)
Sales tax exemption for $100M-$250M investments (varies by county). SB 410 (2026) would repeal. ~$296M in tax breaks by 2025. No disclosure. (StreamDC; AbitOs; MultiState)
No DC-specific incentive. High energy costs, island logistics, limited infrastructure. One DC (DR Fortress) got general job-creation incentive. (WebSearch)
State-level sales tax exemption for qualifying DC developments. Limited details available. No disclosure. (StreamDC; WebSearch)
IL Data Center Investment Program: comprehensive tax exemptions/credits, $250M min investment. Carbon neutrality required within 2yr. Discloses recipients. (StreamDC; NCSL; GJF Cloudy Data)
Sales/use tax exemption up to 25yr ($750M threshold), 50yr for larger. $10M min. Complete exemption on power infra. Discloses via transparency portal. (StreamDC; H5Data; GJF Cloudy Data)
Sales tax breaks from $1M; property tax exemption on equipment. 2025 reform: 10-15yr limit (was indefinite). No disclosure. (StreamDC; NCSL; H5Data)
20yr state/local sales/use tax exemption under SB 98 (2025). $250M min investment, 20 jobs within 2yr. No disclosure. (NCSL; StreamDC)
Sales/use tax exemption, $100M min investment. Expanded under HB 775 (2025). Thresholds vary by county population. No disclosure. (StreamDC; H5Data)
Sales/use tax rebate on equipment/construction (Act 730). $200M investment, 50 jobs, up to 20yr + 10yr extension. No disclosure. (StreamDC; NCSL; WebSearch)
Sales tax refund/exemption for 20K+ sq ft facilities. Limited program scope. No disclosure. (StreamDC)
Sales/use tax exemption: 10yr for $2-5M, 20yr for $250M+, 5 jobs required. HB 560 (2026) would repeal. No disclosure. (StreamDC; Commerce.Maryland.gov; MultiState)
20yr sales/use tax exemption but high thresholds: $50M investment, 100K+ sq ft, 100 jobs. Restrictive eligibility. No disclosure. (StreamDC; WebSearch)
Sales/use tax exemption, $250M+ investment, 30 jobs at 150% regional median wage. Available through 2050/2065. No disclosure. (StreamDC)
20yr sales tax exemption on equipment/energy; permanent property tax exemption. $30M+ investment. 2025 rollback: removed electricity exemption. Discloses recipients. (StreamDC; NCSL; GJF Cloudy Data)
Sales/use tax exemption plus income/franchise tax exemption. $20M investment, 20 jobs at 125% state avg wage. Up to 10yr. No disclosure. (StreamDC; H5Data)
Sales tax exemption: $25M/10 jobs (new), $5M/5 jobs (existing). Modest program. No disclosure. (StreamDC; H5Data)
Property tax reduction (Class 17) for 25K+ sq ft, $50M investment. No sales tax statewide. Limited scope. No disclosure. (StreamDC)
Sales/use tax exemption on equipment/software/construction. LB 1131 (2026) would eliminate personal property tax exemption. No disclosure. (StreamDC; MultiState)
Sales/use tax abatement to 2%; up to 75% personal property tax abatement, 10-20yr. $25M-$100M thresholds. Discloses via legislature reports. (StreamDC; H5Data; GJF Cloudy Data)
No statewide sales tax (natural advantage). No DC-specific incentive. HB 1739 (2026) would create new incentives. (StreamDC; MultiState)
Next NJ Program - AI: up to $250M in tax credits for large-scale projects. New/evolving program. No disclosure. (StreamDC; WebSearch)
No DC-specific incentive. Expansion proposals under consideration in 2026. (StreamDC; MultiState)
Sales tax exemption for Internet data center equipment. Moratorium bill introduced 2026. No disclosure. (StreamDC; H5Data; WebSearch)
Sales/use tax exemption on equipment and electricity. $75M-$225M investment thresholds (varies by county). No disclosure despite other programs being disclosed. (StreamDC; H5Data; GJF Cloudy Data)
Sales/use tax exemption for enterprise IT equipment. 15K+ sq ft, 50%+ data-processing area. Limited scope. No disclosure. (StreamDC)
Sales tax abatement for $100M+ investment, $1.5M+ annual payroll. No tangible personal property tax. Data Center Act. Discloses via tax incentives portal. (StreamDC; H5Data; GJF Cloudy Data)
Sales tax exemption for equipment; majority revenue from out-of-state required. Moratorium bill introduced 2026. No disclosure. (StreamDC; H5Data)
No statewide sales tax. Enterprise Zone abatements, Strategic Investment Program. Not DC-specific. (StreamDC)

Computer Data Center Equipment Program (Act 25/2021): sales/use tax exemption. Keystone Opportunity Zones for state/local breaks. Discloses via tax credit reporting. (StreamDC; PA.gov; GJF Cloudy Data)
No DC-specific incentive. High energy costs, limited suitable land. (StreamDC; WebSearch)
Sales/use tax exemption on equipment/electricity. $50M investment, 25 jobs at 150% county per capita income. Moratorium bill introduced 2026. No disclosure. (StreamDC; H5Data)
No DC-specific incentive. SB 135 (2026) would prohibit any tax incentives to data centers. No sales tax. (StreamDC; MultiState)
Sales/use tax exemption on equipment/infra; 1.5% reduced electricity tax. $100M-$250M investment, 15 jobs at 150% state avg wage. No disclosure. (StreamDC; H5Data)

Sales tax exemption on equipment and electricity. $200M+ investment, 100K+ sq ft, 20+ employees. $1B+ in subsidies FY2025. Most aggressive recruitment. Discloses company names only (no amounts/jobs/locations). (StreamDC; NCSL; CNBC; GJF Cloudy Data)
Sales/use tax exemption on machinery/equipment. 150K+ sq ft min. EDTIF and infrastructure credits. General incentive programs. No disclosure. (StreamDC)
No DC-specific incentive. High energy costs, limited infrastructure, moratorium bill introduced 2026. (StreamDC; WebSearch)

Sales/use tax exemption since 2010. Largest DC market globally. ~$1.6B annually in tax relief. Very aggressive recruitment. Moratorium and reform bills introduced 2026. No disclosure despite massive subsidies. (NCSL; GJF Cloudy Data; MultiState)

Sales/use tax exemption on servers, power infra, installation. Rural and urban counties. Tax break repeal bill advancing (2026). Discloses via tax exemption portal. (StreamDC; H5Data; GJF Cloudy Data; OPB)
New 2025 legislation: sales/use tax exemption; equipment valued at salvage (~5%) for property tax. Aggressive new entrant. No disclosure. (StreamDC; H5Data)
State sales/use tax exemption (WEDC certified). $50M-$150M thresholds by county population. Moratorium bill introduced 2026. Discloses via WEDC awards data. (StreamDC; NCSL; GJF Cloudy Data)
Sales tax exemption on computer equipment ($5M+) and power/cooling ($50M+). No income tax. Limited scope. No disclosure. (StreamDC)
